description: New seller with no reviews replies in slang offering a discount if the buyer skips the platform escrow and transfers (or pays a 50% deposit) to a personal account via WhatsApp.
rationale: Moving payment off the protected escrow to a personal account with competing-buyer pressure is a common marketplace fraud pattern, though phrased casually and without explicit threats.
author: Independent test author agent (Claude), blind to VEILTRACE rules, 2026-10-22
